name: Recode Studios Ltd
tagline: An asset-light, high-ROCE branded beauty & personal-care house (Shark Tank origin) growing 30%+ with a fresh premium-brand acquisition - a real category tailwind, but a tiny, unproven brand on the SME board from an untrusted source.
business_overview: Indian beauty & personal-care (BPC) brand company - colour cosmetics and skincare, sold through salon channel plus general/modern trade and e-commerce. Asset-light: branding, marketing and distribution in-house, all manufacturing outsourced. Promoter holding ~65%. Recently acquired premium beauty brand Aflairza. Seeded as an external lead from X triage (@BeatTheStreet10, untrusted) which ran a bullish deep-dive on pricing power + distribution leverage.
fundamentals_table: Rs 80 Cr / Rs 11.2 Cr; 9M-Dec25: Rs 57.39 Cr / Rs 9.06 Cr
Revenue +~30% FY25; PAT ~12x; operating cash flow turned positive
fundamentals_narrative: Recode is a genuinely attractive small model on paper: asset-light, 30%+ revenue growth, PAT up ~12x, operating cash flow positive, and very high capital efficiency because it owns no plants. The Indian masstige/premium BPC category is on a structural growth path and the salon channel is formalising. The risks are equally clear: revenue is only ~Rs 80 Cr, brand equity is early and colour cosmetics is a crowded, fashion-driven category (Sugar, Swiss Beauty, MyGlamm, Nykaa private labels), the Aflairza acquisition integration is unproven, promoter holding is high, and the only external advocate is an untrusted X account. Valuation at ~24-32x is punchy but not absurd given the growth and ROCE. FY26 results and post-listing disclosure (audited financials, 217x-oversubscribed IPO, continuing analyst engagement) substantially confirm the growth and margin story: revenue +67%, PAT +260%, EBITDA margin nearly doubled to 20.69%. The main fresh caution is Aflairza's own growth stalling to +5.8% in FY26 right before the acquisition, plus the new physical-store format being unproven.
technical_read: Recently listed SME; up sharply since listing. No weekly/monthly structure worth reading.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread (topic_slug null); search returned only a book-review thread. Assessment is web/filings-based. External signal is an untrusted-X deep-dive (@BeatTheStreet10).
community_signal: No trusted-user activity. External lead only: @BeatTheStreet10 (untrusted X triage) - bullish, citing the Aflairza acquisition, pricing power and distribution leverage.
bse_notes: No SEBI / fraud action found. Recent SME listing - limited disclosure history. Watch: Aflairza acquisition accounting and integration, related-party manufacturing/sourcing arrangements, sustained gross-margin as the brand mix shifts, and whether the 9M-Dec25 ROCE/margin level is repeatable at scale.
bull_case: Asset-light, outsourced manufacturing -> very high ROCE/ROE, minimal capex
Revenue +30%, PAT +~12x, operating cash flow positive - real operating leverage
Structural India masstige / premium BPC category growth; salon channel formalising
Aflairza acquisition adds a premium brand and pricing-power optionality
Small base (Rs 80 Cr revenue) - long runway if brands stick
FY26 delivered: PAT +260%, EBITDA margin nearly doubled to 20.69%; May-2026 monthly run-rate (~Rs144 Cr annualised) is accelerating past the FY26 average
bear_case: Tiny, early brand in a crowded, fashion-driven colour-cosmetics category
Aflairza's own revenue growth stalled to +5.8% in FY26 (from +75% FY25) right before the acquisition - an integration-quality flag; only 33% acquired so far (Phase I), full 51% not due until Feb 2027
New physical kiosk/NewU-store format is unproven vs the historically asset-light D2C model - a new capex/opex vector
~65% promoter holding; SME-board history is short even with post-listing disclosure now available
~31-32x earnings already prices strong growth continuation
verdict_headline: Best of the external-lead batch: asset-light, high-ROCE branded-BPC house on a real category tailwind, four_box score 3.0 - but a tiny unproven brand from an untrusted source. thesis_fit 10x-in-2-3-years, conviction Low-Medium, unconfirmed.
verdict_reasoning: four_box: tailwind yes (structural India masstige/premium BPC growth + salon-channel formalisation), tam yes (BPC TAM is large; Recode at Rs 80 Cr revenue has real headroom), moat weak (early brand equity + salon distribution + asset-light high-ROCE model, but colour cosmetics is crowded and brand durability is unproven), valuation weak (~24-32x - punchy for an SME with acquisition-integration risk, not absurd given 30%+ growth / 60% ROCE) -> score 3.0

Score >= 3.0 -> 10x-in-2-3-years permitted. Conviction not mechanically capped, but set to Low-Medium: SME board, untrusted single source, sub-Rs 100 Cr revenue, unproven brand longevity and an unintegrated acquisition. Marked unconfirmed - needs 2-3 quarters of sustained growth + margin and a read on Aflairza before any upgrade.
No live-theme match ('Brand concept' is a candidate name, not an active theme); value_chain block added because the brand-house position is clear from the business description
No red-flag tier (solvent, cash-generative, no SEBI action)

2026-09-12 deep-dive pass 1: FY26 results (PAT +260%, EBITDA margin 12.82%->20.69%) and post-listing execution (accelerating run-rate, real omnichannel build-out, continued promoter buying, no red flags) substantially confirm the original thesis sourced from an untrusted X account. Conviction raised Low-Medium -> Medium; Aflairza's own stalled FY26 growth and the unproven physical-store format keep it short of Medium-High.

four_box.note: moat weak (early brand in crowded colour-cosmetics, durability unproven) and valuation weak (~24-32x on an SME with acquisition-integration risk). tailwind + tam yes (structural BPC growth, large TAM off a Rs 80 Cr base). Score 3.0 permits the return-magnitude label; conviction held at Low-Medium / unconfirmed on execution + source risk.

value_chain.theme: Branded beauty & personal care (masstige / premium BPC)

value_chain.note: Category is structurally growing and the asset-light model is capital-efficient, but this is a supply-side 'adding' market - many new brands - and Recode's brand is small and young; distribution leverage is the thing to verify.

annual_report_findings: Recode listed on BSE SME 2026-05-12 (IPO Rs 44.6 Cr, 217.89x subscribed, listed at +34.87% premium) — now has real public listed disclosure, materially reducing the 'thin/opaque SME' concern the original untrusted-X-sourced write-up flagged
FY26: revenue Rs 79.95 Cr (+67.27% YoY), PAT Rs 11.21 Cr (+260.28% YoY), EBITDA Rs 16.54 Cr (+170%); EBITDA margin nearly doubled 12.82% (FY25) -> 20.69% (FY26); PAT margin 6.51% -> 14.02%

Aflairza acquisition: Phase I completed 2026-07-23 (33% stake, Rs 8.32 Cr, Rs 285/share); full 51% stake targeted by Feb 2027 — still a staged, incomplete acquisition. Aflairza's own standalone revenue: Rs 4.44 Cr (FY24) -> Rs 7.77 Cr (FY25, +75%) -> Rs 8.22 Cr (FY26, +5.8%) — growth stalled sharply in the very year of acquisition, a real integration-quality flag not visible in the original write-up

6 promoters (Dheeraj Bansal, Rahul Sachdeva, Shelly Bansal, Shalini Trehan, Preeti Trehan, Karan Bansal) hold ~65% aggregate; continued small open-market purchases in Jun 2026 (insider-confidence signal, modest scale); no pledge found, no SEBI/fraud action found
quarterly_trend: Monthly revenue run-rate crossed Rs 12 Cr in May 2026 (~Rs 144 Cr annualised) — well ahead of the FY26 full-year average (~Rs 6.7 Cr/month), a real acceleration signal post-listing

Company opened 7 premium retail kiosks across 6 cities and its first 'NewU' store (targeting 15-20 more in FY27), shifting from D2C-digital toward a hybrid 'Phygital' model with a stated 500+ offline-touchpoint target
Launched 'Recode Luxe' professional range in the last ~90 days
Management guided 50%+ FY27 revenue growth (on the Rs 79.95 Cr FY26 base, implying ~Rs 120 Cr+)
key_new_facts: FY26 results and post-listing disclosures substantially de-risk the original 'single untrusted-X-source' framing — the company now has audited financials, an oversubscribed IPO, and continuing analyst/investor engagement
Margin trajectory is real and accelerating (EBITDA margin +788bps FY25->FY26), not just a revenue story
Aflairza's own growth stalled in FY26 (+5.8% vs +75% the prior year) right before Recode's acquisition — a genuine integration-quality question the original write-up could not have flagged

The company is building real omnichannel/physical distribution (kiosks, NewU stores) rather than staying purely digital-D2C, addressing part of the 'moat weak' concern, though this is unproven and adds a new capex/opex execution vector
open_questions: Whether Aflairza's stalled FY26 growth reverses once integrated, or drags on blended margins/growth
Unit economics of the new physical kiosk/store format vs the historically asset-light D2C model

deep_dive.conviction_update: Low-Medium -> Medium. FY26 results (PAT +260%, EBITDA margin nearly doubled) and post-listing execution (accelerating run-rate, real store rollout, continued promoter buying, no red flags) substantially confirm the growth thesis the prior pass could only source from an untrusted X account. Held short of Medium-High by the Aflairza integration question (its own growth stalled pre-acquisition) and full valuation (~31-32x).
